unchanged_definition: One native-style TAL assignment per batch before the classification mask; no rematching based on ignores
Box/DFL computations, target-score denominator, gains and inherited batch multiplier retain the pinned native definitions
Only background classification rows whose anchor centers fall in explicit half-open ignore regions are zeroed; all channels of TAL positives are retained
The empty-GT floating foreground output is converted to boolean only for the strict helper argument; the original assignment tuple is returned unchanged
gradient_boundary: Positive priority preserves the local derivative of classification loss with respect to each positive score-logit row at the same predictions/assignment. It does not preserve all global model gradients: ignored-background classification contributions to shared parameters are deliberately removed. Later model parameters, assignments and regression values may therefore change. The component unit tests, rather than these scalar receipts, establish the local positive-score gradient equality and fixed-input box/DFL equality.
claims_not_supported: No AP or training-benefit claim follows from a smaller masked BCE
No claim that all global model/feature gradients remain equal under nonempty ignore
No improvement or invariance of box/DFL over a changed training trajectory
No real-data training qualification, generalization, scientific Gate1 pass, CUDA capture or deployment acceptance
